🚀 We're hiring: Backend Engineer (Remote, EU time zones)

Our team is growing, and we're looking for a backend engineer to help us build fast, reliable systems that our customers count on every day.

What you'll work with:
🔹 Go for our services
🔹 Postgres as our main datastore
🔹 A small, collaborative team that cares about clean code, careful reviews, and shipping often

What we offer:
💶 A salary band of €70,000–€95,000, based on experience
🌍 Fully remote work, as long as you're in an EU time zone
🤝 Real ownership. Your work goes to production and makes a difference.

Our hiring process is simple and respects your time. There are 3 interview rounds:
1️⃣ An intro call to get to know each other and talk about the role
2️⃣ A technical conversation about how you design and build backend systems
3️⃣ A final meeting with the team so you can see how we work together

You're a good fit if you've built and run production services, you like solving hard data problems, and you enjoy working with people who care about their craft.

Interested? Apply through the link or send me a DM. Sharing this with someone in your network also helps a lot! 🙌
